style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Wreath with Velvet Bow
style.toneOfVoice: Make a sophisticated statement this season with this 60cm artificial wreath, adorned with lush, lifelike greenery and finished with a luxurious navy velvet bow. The deep navy hue brings a modern, elegant twist to traditional wreath décor—perfect for those who love a classic look with a fresh edge. Whether gracing your front door, fireplace, or interior wall, this wreath offers effortless style and lasting charm. Bold yet timeless, this wreath is the perfect blend of tradition and modern luxury—designed to elevate your seasonal décor. Wreath width: D60cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
